summary: Implemented CBTS-932 (Create a list): createListAction Server Action validates and creates a List row and revalidates the home page; ListsView and CreateListForm components render the list and the creation form; app/page.tsx reads lists via Prisma. No schema/migration changes (List model already existed). Also cleaned up syntax across the app (no semicolons, no trailing commas, import grouping/order, no space before self-closing JSX tags) and documented the new conventions in next-js-syntax.md and next-js-code-guidelines.md.
